purpose: Test whether apparent main-body height and south-terrace longitudinal extent are dominant perceptual errors before promoting any new Scene metric.

height_transform_policy.guard: Reject a variant if coherent scaling makes doors/windows implausible or destroys the three-level reading; do not compensate missing terrain by crushing the house.

terrace_transform_policy.change_only: longitudinal extent of the represented timber terrace
terrace_transform_policy.unknown_policy: Extending the visible-order proxy must not assert the exact hidden contour or floor continuity through the occluded masonry/stair zone.

order: choose one order of magnitude for each variable
only if Scene gain is clear, generate full BrickModel and viewer-faithful render
comparison_gate.question: At first glance, is this more recognizably this house?

note: All numeric alternatives in this manifest are sensitivity sliders, not measurements or promoted Scene truth.
